events.verdict: Thompson (HOU) establishes himself in a screening position in Ball's (CHA) path and does not deliver contact. He turns to move towards the basket and releases away from Ball.
At the end of Mann's (CHA) drive to the basket, Green (HOU) briefly rests his arm on his back but the contact does not affect Mann's SQBR.
As the ball is scored, Smith Jr. (HOU) and Richards (CHA) engage and disengage.
Williams (CHA) initiates more-than-marginal contact to Green's (HOU) arm during his driving shot attempt.
Williams (CHA) plants his right foot in Brooks' (HOU) path and as he shifts his body over, he delivers contact to Brooks during the screen.
As Sengun (HOU) loses control of the ball, he slips the contact with Mann (CHA) and avoids dislodging him from his defensive position,.
Green (HOU) avoids making contact to Mann's (CHA) arm and legally contests his driving shot attempt.
Brooks (HOU) grabs and pulls Williams' (CHA) left arm, causing him to fall to the floor as he attempts to secure the rebound.
Smith Jr (HOU) commits a take foul on Ball (CHA).
Thompson (HOU) commits a take foul on Ball (CHA).
Williams (CHA) initiates contact to Smith Jr.'s (HOU) wrist, affecting his jump shot attempt.
Eason (HOU) commits a take foul on Mann (CHA).
